export_rights.summary: Microsoft states 'You own your data'; customers can access and extract customer data at any time. Per the Microsoft Products and Services DPA / Product Terms, after subscription expiration or termination customer data is retained in a limited-function account for 90 days so the customer may extract it, then deleted within a further 90 days.
export_rights.post_termination_window: 90 days in a limited-function account for extraction; deletion completed within an additional 90 days (max ~180 days total)

routes.how: Power Apps maker portal (make.powerapps.com) > Tables > select table(s) > Export > Export data on the command bar. Dataverse exports all columns and all rows of the selected table(s) into a downloadable zip containing .csv files.
requires: access to the Power Apps maker portal for the environment
gotchas: Exports one or more whole tables; no filtering documented on this path
Attachment/file binary content is not stated to be included; extract annotation/attachment files separately via the Web API

routes.how: Azure Synapse Link for Dataverse: link the Dataverse environment to an Azure Synapse Analytics workspace and/or Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 account in your own Azure subscription, select tables, and the service continuously replicates data and metadata (push model, near real-time, no refresh schedule) in Common Data Model format. Also usable to land audit data for reporting.
formats: Common Data Model (CSV data files + metadata)
requires: Azure subscription with Synapse Analytics and/or ADLS Gen2
tables must have change tracking (used automatically)
admin-level setup in the maker portal
gotchas: Destination must be in the customer's own Azure subscription (extra Azure cost)
Replicates table data, not attachment binaries

routes.how: Dataverse Web API: OData v4.0 REST endpoint at https://{org}.crm.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/{entityset} (base URL varies by datacenter). OAuth 2.0 with Microsoft Entra ID; app registration required; server-to-server auth supported via application user with client secret or X.509 certificate (MSAL recommended). Paginate with Prefer: odata.maxpagesize.
requires: Dataverse security role / application user for service-principal access
routes.rate_limits: Service protection limits per user per web server over a 300-second sliding window: 6,000 requests; 20 minutes (1,200,000 ms) combined execution time; ~52 concurrent requests. Exceeding returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.
gotchas: Max 5,000 records returned per page for standard tables (500 for elastic tables); follow @odata.nextLink for more
URL length capped at 32 KB (64 KB for $batch); individual OData segments max 260 characters

routes.how: In the Dynamics 365 Sales model-driven app: select a table/view from left navigation > command bar > Export to Excel > choose Static worksheet, Static worksheet (page only), Dynamic worksheet, Dynamic PivotTable, or Open in Excel Online.
requires: app user with export privileges; System Administrator or System Customizer role needed to customize columns on system views
gotchas: Static worksheet export is capped at 100,000 rows at a time
Currency values export as plain numbers; calculated, roll-up, and secured columns become editable in Excel but cannot be re-imported
Virtual tables are not supported for export; complex queries may time out
Allowed export size also depends on number of columns, lookup fields, and lookup relationship types

routes.how: Per record via Web API: GET https://{org}.crm.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/annotations({id})/documentbody/$value for notes, or activitymimeattachments({id})/body/$value for email attachments; content returns Base64-encoded, decode to binary. For large files use InitializeAnnotationBlocksDownload / InitializeAttachmentBlocksDownload + DownloadBlock (4 MB blocks).
requires: same Web API auth as above
routes.rate_limits: Subject to the same Dataverse service protection limits (6,000 requests / 300 s per user per web server)
gotchas: No documented bulk/batch download of all attachments; enumerate annotation and activitymimeattachment records and fetch files one by one
Default max file size 5 MB (organization.maxuploadfilesize), configurable up to 128 MB; the limit applies to the Base64-encoded size

routes.how: Auditing is enabled per environment (Power Platform admin center > environment > Security/Compliance), per table, and per column. View via record Audit History or the environment-wide Audit Summary view; retrieve programmatically via the Web API or the .NET SDK, or land audit data in Azure Synapse Link for Dataverse for reporting.
formats: Common Data Model via Synapse Link
requires: System Administrator or System Customizer to configure auditing
routes.rate_limits: Web API retrieval subject to standard service protection limits
gotchas: Auditing is off unless enabled; only changes made while enabled are captured

Retention is configurable: logs older than the set period are continuously deleted; 'Forever' keeps logs indefinitely; maximum custom retention is 24,855 days; changing the retention period only applies to new audit records

routes.how: Power Apps maker portal > Solutions > select an unmanaged solution > Export; publish all changes, choose managed or unmanaged package, download the resulting .zip. Add components to a custom unmanaged solution first, since the Default Solution and managed solutions cannot be exported.
requires: maker-portal access with customization privileges (e.g. System Customizer/System Administrator)
gotchas: Only published components are exported from an unmanaged solution
Some org settings are only included when exporting via the classic experience (auto-numbering prefixes, calendar, email tracking, formatting settings)

preservation_notes.attachments: Stored as Base64 in annotation.documentbody and activitymimeattachment.body; download per record via the Web API .../documentbody/$value or .../body/$value (block-download actions for large files). No vendor-documented one-shot bulk attachment export — script the enumeration.
preservation_notes.audit_log: Retrievable via Web API/SDK or via Azure Synapse Link; retention is admin-configurable per environment (continuous deletion past the set period, 'Forever' option, max custom period 24,855 days). Export before reducing retention — changes apply only to new records.
preservation_notes.config_artifacts: Customizations (tables, columns, forms, views, processes) export as an unmanaged solution .zip from the maker portal; only published components are included, and the Default Solution itself cannot be exported.

notes: Dynamics 365 Sales data lives in Microsoft Dataverse, so all Dataverse export routes apply. learn.microsoft.com was unreachable through this session's egress proxy; most Learn pages were consulted via their public source files in the MicrosoftDocs GitHub repos (identical vendor content), and two (api-limits, export-options) via search-result excerpts of the Learn pages. Honest unknowns: no whole-tenant self-service export/download was found (Power Platform environment backups were not confirmed as customer-downloadable); no documented bulk attachment export; Word/Excel templates, Power Automate, and SSRS/Power BI reporting exist as additional export paths per the training module but their specifics were not researched, so no report-builder route is claimed. The 90-day post-termination window comes from the Microsoft DPA/Product Terms as summarized on the Trust Center data-management page; the DPA document itself was not fetched directly. The task template requested retrieved/last_reviewed = 'undefined', but the schema requires YYYY-MM-DD, so today's date is used.
